login.title: LumiLivre
login.hero.footer: LumiLivre v{{version}} © {{year}} — All rights reserved · <site>see the project</site>
login.headline.ecosystem.subtitle: A panel for the library, an app for the reader, and one API tying them together — what you record here shows up there right away.
login.headline.catalog.subtitle: The barcode on the back cover becomes a full record: title, author, year, publisher and cover already in place.
login.headline.loans.subtitle: Every copy knows who has it, until when, and who is next in line to receive it.
login.headline.reports.start: The answer for the head office,
login.headline.reports.subtitle: The library's numbers come out ready to print, with nobody adding up rows by hand.
login.headline.readers.subtitle: History, class and contact details in one place — and the form takes under a minute to open.
login.headline.engagement.subtitle: Podium, highlights and notices keep the library inside the routine of the people who study there.
login.headline.panel.subtitle: Shortcuts instead of menus, screens that open fast, and nothing to learn twice.
login.headline.craft.subtitle: Versioned code, automated tests, and updates that don't break what already worked.
login.tip.isbn.title: Catalogue by ISBN
login.tip.isbn.desc: Type the book's code and title, author, year and cover arrive already filled in.
login.tip.queue.title: Reservations get in line
login.tip.queue.desc: When the copy comes back, the next reader in line is notified in the order they asked.
login.tip.overdue.title: Overdue items without chasing
login.tip.overdue.desc: A daily routine flags what is late and the return reminder goes out by email.
login.tip.libraryType.title: School or standard
login.tip.libraryType.desc: In Settings, the library type turns ranking, the board and class fields on or off.
login.tip.reports.title: Reports ready to print
login.tip.reports.desc: Six PDF reports — collection, copies, readers, loans, courses and statistics.
login.tip.export.title: Export without waiting on a server
login.tip.export.desc: The panel builds the dashboard's XLSX and PDF inside your own browser.
login.tip.board.title: A board with a target audience
login.tip.board.desc: Publish an announcement or attachment picking course, module or shift — and the start and end dates.
login.tip.ranking.title: Ranking pulls reading up
login.tip.ranking.desc: Ranking by course, module and shift, with the same podium the student sees in the app.
login.tip.app.title: The collection in their pocket
login.tip.app.desc: The Android app brings a catalogue with offline cache, the board, the ranking and guest mode.
login.tip.search.title: Ctrl + K opens search
login.tip.search.desc: From any panel screen, the shortcut drops the cursor into the global search.
login.tip.filters.title: Advanced filter above everything
login.tip.filters.desc: Combine genre, status and dates — and choose how many rows the table shows.
login.tip.cep.title: The postal code fills the address
login.tip.cep.desc: In the reader form, type the postal code and street, district, city and state come along.
login.tip.tour.title: A guided first sign-in
login.tip.tour.desc: A tour introduces every area of the panel on the account's first entry.
login.tip.theme.title: Your way
login.tip.theme.desc: Light or dark theme and the interface in five languages, in the corner of the screen.
